response.sql: WITH type_counts AS (SELECT tr.tradekind, COUNT(DISTINCT tx.transreg) AS transaction_count FROM advancedbehavior ab JOIN transactionrecord tx ON tx.transreg = ab.translink JOIN trader tr ON tr.tradereg = tx.trdref WHERE tr.tradekind IS NOT NULL GROUP BY tr.tradekind), type_stats AS (SELECT transaction_count, transaction_count::numeric / SUM(transaction_count) OVER () AS share, AVG(transaction_count::numeric) OVER () AS average_count FROM type_counts) SELECT SUM(transaction_count) AS sum_counts, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(transaction_count - average_count) AS average_excess FROM type_stats WHERE transaction_count > average_count

assumptions.assumption: The average is across trader types represented by at least one qualifying analysis; NULL is not a trader type.

alternatives.interpretation: Include trader types present in the trader table even when they have no qualifying analysed transaction.
alternatives.sql: WITH trader_types AS (SELECT DISTINCT tradekind FROM trader WHERE tradekind IS NOT NULL), type_counts AS (SELECT tt.tradekind, COUNT(DISTINCT tx.transreg) AS transaction_count FROM trader_types tt LEFT JOIN trader tr ON tr.tradekind = tt.tradekind LEFT JOIN transactionrecord tx ON tx.trdref = tr.tradereg AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM advancedbehavior ab WHERE ab.translink = tx.transreg) GROUP BY tt.tradekind), type_stats AS (SELECT transaction_count, transaction_count::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(transaction_count) OVER (), 0) AS share, AVG(transaction_count::numeric) OVER () AS average_count FROM type_counts) SELECT SUM(transaction_count) AS sum_counts, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(transaction_count - average_count) AS average_excess FROM type_stats WHERE transaction_count > average_count
